findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seo_audit, web_read, eu_einvoice_from_scan, web_url_safety, ai_prompt_injection, web_ui_check · Private data: de_crypto_tax_holding_period, x402_recommend, crypto_wallet_balances, crypto_token_scan, eu_einvoice, eu_vat_check, eu_einvoice_from_scan, us_filings_recent, eu_tenders_bid_draft, fin_used_price_estimate, web_url_safety · Public sink: web_read, web_domain_intel, eu_einvoice, de_impressum, eu_einvoice_validate, eu_einvoice_from_scan, de_power_green_hours, eu_energy_green_window, ai_prompt_injection, web_ui_check · Destructive: eu_vat_check, eu_iban_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seo_audit, web_read, eu_einvoice_from_scan, web_url_safety, ai_prompt_injection, web_ui_check · Private data: de_crypto_tax_holding_period, x402_recommend, crypto_wallet_balances, crypto_token_scan, eu_einvoice, eu_vat_check, eu_einvoice_from_scan, us_filings_recent, eu_tenders_bid_draft, fin_used_price_estimate, web_url_safety · Public sink: web_read, web_domain_intel, eu_einvoice, de_impressum, eu_einvoice_validate, eu_einvoice_from_scan, de_power_green_hours, eu_energy_green_window, ai_prompt_injection, web_ui_check · Destructive: eu_vat_check, eu_iban_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
